title: Aqua Dome Tirol Therme Längenfeld
highlights: Futuristic thermal resort architecture featuring three levitating outdoor bowl pools
Genuine geothermal sulfur spring emerging from 1,865 meters underground
Alpen Arche Noah family water park with children pools and funnel tire slides
Spectacular Gletscherglühen sauna village offering panoramic vistas of the Ötztal Alps
kurzbeschreibung: The Aqua Dome in Längenfeld is Tirol's largest thermal spa, featuring floating basin bowls and thermal sulphur water.
beschreibung:
Futuristic Thermal World in the Ötztal

The Aqua Dome in Längenfeld is among the most modern and architecturally striking thermal resorts in the Alps. The three bowl-shaped outdoor basins, seemingly floating weightlessly in the air, are the world-famous trademark of the Tirol Therme Längenfeld.

Healing Thermal Water and Alpine Wellness

Warm sulphur water bubbles up from a depth of around 1,865 metres, creating a soothing sanctuary in the open-air basins. A dedicated family area named Alpen Arche Noah offers waterslides and fun play areas for children, while visitors in search of serenity enjoy luxurious indulgence in the Gletscherglühen sauna world.
